import json,resource,signal
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(170,175));signal.alarm(180)

paths += ['book/_static/'+name+'/manifest.json' for name in ('constructive-gcd-congruence-explorer-v34','constructive-polynomial-euclidean-explorer-v34','constructive-research-explorer-v34','constructive-completed-lower-explorer-v34','constructive-historical-explorers-v34')]
rows={}
for rel in paths:
 p=root/rel; assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(); before=p.stat(); h=sha256(); size=0
 with p.open('rb') as f:
  for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''): size+=len(block);h.update(block)

 rows[rel]={'bytes':size,'sha256':h.hexdigest()}
print(json.dumps({'observation_only':True,'timing':'after all twelve installed-service cases completed','pins':rows},sort_keys=True))
